Download **bambu-deck-0.1.4.streamDeckPlugin** and double-click it; Stream Deck installs the plugin along with its profiles.

- New key "Vorheizen": PLA, PETG, ABS/ASA, TPU or cool down. Shows how far the nozzle got; press again to switch off
- New key "Lüfter": part, auxiliary or chamber fan, off → 50 % → 100 %, the fan on the key turns with it
- New key "Druckinfo": when the print will be done (clock time), time left, layer or file name
- New key "Achsen": home (G28) or Z ±10 mm
- New key "Filament": load a spool from the AMS (shown in its colour) or unload
- New key "G-Code": your own macro with its own name
- Whatever heats, moves or swaps filament only works while the printer is not printing; the key turns grey meanwhile
- The XL starter profile uses its free keys for the new controls
